toc-c1-t01.title: Alphabet
toc-c1-t01.definition: Alphabet Σ = a finite, non-empty set of symbols. String over Σ = a finite sequence of symbols of Σ. ε = empty string (length 0). Σ* = all strings over Σ (including ε); Σ⁺ = Σ* − {ε}.
toc-c1-t01.simpleExplanation: Alphabet matlab 'kaunse symbols allowed hain' (jaise 0 aur 1). String matlab un symbols ko line me jodkar bana word, jaise 0110. ε ka matlab khaali string — kuch bhi nahi.
toc-c1-t01.whyUsed: Har automaton aur grammar isi se start hota hai: pehle batana padta hai input kin symbols se banega.
toc-c1-t01.realLifeAnalogy: Alphabet = keyboard ki keys; string = un keys se type kiya hua word.
coreConcept: Σ finite hona chahiye aur empty nahi.
Σ* = Σ⁰ ∪ Σ¹ ∪ Σ² ∪ … (infinite set, par har string finite).
Concatenation xy = x ke baad y; εw = wε = w.

steps: Strings banao: symbols ko ek ke baad ek jodo.
Length = symbols ki ginti (ε ki length 0).
Σⁿ chahiye? Har position par |Σ| choices → |Σ|ⁿ strings.
Prefix = shuru ka hissa, suffix = end ka hissa, substring = beech ka continuous hissa.
toc-c1-t01.example: Σ = {a, b}: Σ² likho aur |Σ³| nikalo.
exampleSteps: Σ² = length-2 strings: aa, ab, ba, bb → 4 strings.
Σ* = {ε, a, b, aa, ab, ba, bb, aaa, …} — infinite.

examExample.question: Σ = {0,1} par length ≤ 3 wali kitni strings hain?

keyPoints: Σ finite aur non-empty hota hai.
ε alphabet ka symbol nahi, ek string hai.
Σ* infinite hai, Σⁿ finite hai.
commonMistakes: ε ko symbol samajhna — ε string hai (length 0).
Σ⁺ me ε include kar dena.
toc-c1-t01.quickRevision: Σ = finite symbols; string = unka sequence; |Σⁿ| = |Σ|ⁿ; Σ* me ε hai, Σ⁺ me nahi.
mustKnow: Σ* = sab strings (ε sahit); Σ⁺ = Σ* − {ε}
toc-c1-t01.memoryTrick: Star (*) = 'zero ya zyada' (ε included); Plus (+) = 'kam se kam ek'.
ifYouKnow: Σ* aur Σ⁺ ka fark batana.

vivaQuestions.question: ε kya hai?
vivaQuestions.answer: Empty string, jiski length 0 hoti hai.

vivaQuestions.question: Σ* aur Σ⁺ me fark?
vivaQuestions.answer: Σ* me ε hai, Σ⁺ me nahi.

examQuestions.question: Σ = {a,b,c} par length-2 wali kitni strings?

knowledgeCheck.question: Σ* vs Σ⁺ — ek fark?
knowledgeCheck.answer: Σ* me ε hota hai, Σ⁺ me nahi.

toc-c1-t01.visualGuide: Diagram/table ko aise padho: pehle Σ dekho — allowed symbols. Phir Σⁿ ki row dekho: har position par |Σ| choices hoti hain, isliye |Σⁿ| = |Σ|ⁿ. Σ* ko finite list mat samjho; woh saari possible finite strings ka infinite collection hai, aur ε usme zaroor hota hai.
